node_definition.done_when: Done when. A test orders three queued pointers, one with no queued_at , and reads the other two ranked in their usual order, with the third reported by run id. A second test composes a plan review while such a pointer is in the queue and reads the review composed. A third test reads every path that writes a queued pointer giving it a readable queued_at . A negative control that raises on the unreadable pointer fails the first two tests. The gate runs on all_debug and its log is written to the section's evidence fragment.
